note: The same rooftop as jp-ws-jingumae-4-12-10-romaji, in the oracle's OWN canonical rendering — kept verbatim because of what it contains. (1) The separator inside '12−10' is U+2212 MINUS SIGN, not U+002D HYPHEN, while the '4-' immediately before it IS an ASCII hyphen: one span, two different dashes, from the same generator. Any tooling that 'cleans' this row silently deletes the case. (2) '〒' (U+3012) is the postal mark, a sigil prefixing the code and not part of it, with no tag. (3) Latin admin names sit beside a kanji/katakana building name in one string. (4) Country leads rather than trails. building_name carries the complex and its wing space-joined (Omotesandō Hills / Zelkova Terrace) — the union has one building_name, so the two-level building identity is unexpressible.
